title: Jelly Ball Chain Pop
description: Trace long glossy chains across a 3D bubble grid, pop huge clusters before moves run dry, and drop bombs to blast through tight goals.
controls: Press and drag through adjacent balls of the same color, then release to pop. Trigger bombs when moves get tight.

zh-CN.title: 弹珠连线爆爆乐
zh-CN.description: 一指划过满屏果冻感立体彩球，连得越长、爆得越爽！步数紧巴巴的时候甩出一颗骷髅炸弹瞬间清场，专治各种不开心。
zh-CN.controls: 按住相邻的同色彩球一笔连到底，松手立刻噼里啪啦消一片，攒够金币随时炸翻全场！
